range: rank 121-130 minus rank 126 (awaiting Chinese title resolution)

entries.summaryZh: 1877年11月17日夜，俄军在高加索战场攻取奥斯曼帝国重镇卡尔斯。此前俄军7月的围攻被击退，此番改由洛里斯-梅利科夫指挥，先夺取东部防御工事，再切断侯赛因帕夏守军的退路，大批奥斯曼官兵被俘。战后签订的条约使卡尔斯割让给俄国，直到1921年才归还土耳其。
entries.summaryEn: On the night of 17 November 1877 Russian forces in the Caucasus stormed Kars, the key Ottoman fortress that had repelled their siege in July. Under Loris-Melikov the Russians seized the eastern works and cut off Hussein Pasha's garrison, capturing most of it. The later treaty ceded Kars to Russia, which held the city until 1921.
entries.significanceZh: 卡尔斯之战是1877年至1878年俄土战争高加索战场的决定性胜利，直接导致卡尔斯被割让给俄国。
entries.significanceEn: Kars decided the Caucasus theatre of the Russo-Turkish War of 1877-1878 and led directly to the cession of the city to Russia.
entries.notesZh: 中文维基与英文维基均系于1877年11月17日；战役为时一夜，本条只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: Both Wikipedia articles date the assault to 17 November 1877; the fighting lasted a single night and the entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 1914年11月3日，第一次世界大战东非战场初期，英军与德属东非殖民部队在乞力马扎罗山南麓的朗吉多发生前哨战。英军试图越过英属东非与德属东非的边界推进，被德军击退，双方伤亡都不大。此役表明协约国在东非的初期攻势受阻，战事由此转入长期消耗。
entries.summaryEn: On 3 November 1914, early in the East African campaign of the First World War, British and Indian troops clashed with the German colonial force at Longido on the southern slopes of Kilimanjaro. The British attempt to cross from British East Africa into German territory was repulsed with light casualties, showing that the Allied advance would be slow.
entries.significanceZh: 乞力马扎罗山战役标志着东非战场英军首次攻势受挫，此后战事长期化。
entries.significanceEn: Kilimanjaro marked the first check to the British advance in East Africa and the start of a long attritional campaign.
entries.notesZh: 中文维基只记年份与地点，英文维基给出1914年11月；本条保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: Chinese Wikipedia gives the year and place only while English Wikipedia dates the action to November 1914; the entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 1950年6月25日至26日，朝鲜战争爆发首日，朝鲜人民军一艘载有数百名第766独立步兵团士兵的运输艇试图在釜山附近登陆，遭韩国海军巡逻舰截击并被击沉。此役是朝鲜战争最早的水面战斗之一，也是韩国海军在战争初期取得的重要胜利。
entries.summaryEn: On 25-26 June 1950, the first day of the Korean War, a North Korean transport carrying hundreds of soldiers of the 766th Independent Infantry Regiment tried to land near Busan but was intercepted and sunk by the South Korean patrol ship ROKS Baekdusan. It was one of the earliest surface actions of the war and an important South Korean victory.
entries.significanceZh: 朝鲜海峡海战是朝鲜战争最早的水面交战之一，挫败了朝鲜人民军在釜山附近登陆的企图。
entries.significanceEn: Korea Strait was among the first surface actions of the Korean War and foiled a North Korean attempt to land near Busan.
entries.notesZh: 中文维基记6月25日，英文维基记6月25日至26日；本条只保留年份精度，不折算月日。
entries.notesEn: Chinese Wikipedia gives 25 June while English Wikipedia gives 25-26 June; the entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 1990年8月2日，伊拉克军队入侵科威特当天，在科威特城的达斯曼宫与科威特埃米尔的卫队交战。埃米尔贾比尔·艾哈迈德·萨巴赫事前已经转移，其弟法赫德亲王在保卫王宫时阵亡。伊军当日控制王宫并占领全城，海湾战争由此爆发，科威特随后被伊拉克吞并。
entries.summaryEn: On 2 August 1990, the day Iraqi forces invaded Kuwait, fighting broke out at Dasman Palace in Kuwait City between the Iraqi army and the Emir's guard. The Emir had already moved to safety, but his brother Sheikh Fahad was killed defending the palace. Iraqi troops took the palace and the city that day, beginning the Gulf War.
entries.significanceZh: 达斯曼宫之战是伊拉克入侵科威特的开端性交战，标志着海湾战争的爆发。
entries.significanceEn: Dasman Palace was the opening engagement of the Iraqi invasion and marked the start of the Gulf War.
entries.notesZh: 中英文维基均系于1990年8月2日；王宫陷落的具体时刻与埃米尔撤离时间各家记载不一。
entries.notesEn: Both Wikipedia articles give 2 August 1990; accounts differ on the exact hour the palace fell and on when the Emir left.

entries.summaryZh: 2017年1月底至2月初，乌克兰政府军与顿巴斯分离武装在顿涅茨克州阿夫迪伊夫卡附近展开激烈交战，是顿巴斯战争中伤亡最集中的阶段之一。战斗围绕工业区与交通线反复争夺，居民区一度断水断电。欧洲安全与合作组织观察团称这是2015年以来乌东最激烈的战斗。
entries.summaryEn: From late January to early February 2017 Ukrainian government forces and separatist units fought around Avdiivka in Donetsk Oblast in one of the deadliest episodes of the war in Donbas. The fighting centred on the industrial zone and transport links, leaving residents without water and power; OSCE monitors called it the worst violence in eastern Ukraine since 2015.
entries.significanceZh: 阿夫迪伊夫卡之战是2015年明斯克协议后乌东最激烈的交战，显示停火机制难以约束前线冲突。
entries.significanceEn: Avdiivka was the fiercest fighting in eastern Ukraine after the 2015 Minsk agreement and showed how weakly the ceasefire constrained the front.
entries.notesZh: 本条专指2017年1月至2月的交战，与2022年后的同名战役无关；维基数据P585记为2017年。
entries.notesEn: This entry is the January-February 2017 engagement and not the later battle of the same name after 2022; Wikidata P585 records 2017.

entries.summaryZh: 198年冬到199年初，曹操与刘备联军围攻吕布据守的下邳，引沂水、泗水灌城。吕布部将侯成等人开城投降，吕布被擒杀，其割据徐州的力量覆亡。此役消除了曹操在官渡之战前被吕布从后方袭击的隐患，为曹操集中兵力对抗袁绍创造了条件。
entries.summaryEn: From the winter of 198 to early 199 Cao Cao and Liu Bei besieged Lü Bu at Xiapi and diverted the Si and Yi rivers to flood the city. Lü Bu's officers opened the gates and he was captured and executed, ending his hold on Xu Province and clearing Cao Cao's rear before the campaign against Yuan Shao.
entries.significanceZh: 下邳之战消灭了吕布势力，使曹操得以在官渡之战前解除后方威胁。
entries.significanceEn: Xiapi destroyed Lü Bu's power and freed Cao Cao's rear before the decisive battle of Guandu.
entries.notesZh: 中文维基系于建安三年（198年至199年初），英文维基给出198年冬至199年2月7日；本条采用P585的199年并保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: Chinese Wikipedia dates the siege to Jian'an 3 (late 198 to early 199) and English Wikipedia to the winter of 198 to 7 February 199; the entry follows P585, the year 199, at year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 208年10月，曹操率轻骑在当阳长坂坡追击南撤的刘备军。刘备弃辎重与家属而走，赵云于乱军中救出刘禅，张飞据水断桥喝退曹军。此役虽以刘备军溃退告终，却使其保存了核心人马，得以退往江夏与孙权结盟，成为赤壁之战的前哨战，也因赵云的救主而广为人知。
entries.summaryEn: In October 208 Cao Cao's light cavalry caught Liu Bei's retreating force at Changban near Dangyang. Liu Bei abandoned his baggage and family; Zhao Yun rescued his infant son and Zhang Fei held a broken bridge with a handful of men, deterring pursuit. The defeat nonetheless preserved Liu Bei's core following and led on to the Red Cliffs campaign.
entries.significanceZh: 长坂坡之战使刘备得以保存实力退往江夏，促成孙刘联盟，是赤壁之战的前哨战。
entries.significanceEn: Changban let Liu Bei preserve his force and reach Jiangxia, enabling the Sun-Liu alliance that fought at Red Cliffs.
entries.notesZh: 中英文维基均记208年；长坂在今湖北荆门南，各本所系月份不一，本条只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: Both Wikipedia articles give 208; the site lies south of present-day Jingmen in Hubei and the recorded month varies, so the entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 1965年6月9日至13日，越南战争期间，越南南方民族解放阵线在福隆省同帅发动夏季攻势的高潮战，攻击南越军队与美军顾问驻地。战斗以越共获胜告终，南越方面损失惨重。此役暴露了南越军队的指挥与协同问题，也促使美军进一步扩大在越南的介入。
entries.summaryEn: From 9 to 13 June 1965, at the climax of the Viet Cong summer offensive, the National Liberation Front attacked South Vietnamese and American positions at Dong Xoai in Phuoc Long Province. The battle ended in a Viet Cong victory with heavy South Vietnamese losses; it exposed command failures in the South Vietnamese army and preceded deeper American involvement.
entries.significanceZh: 同帅战役是1965年越共夏季攻势的高潮，加速了美军对越南战事的直接介入。
entries.significanceEn: Dong Xoai was the climax of the 1965 Viet Cong summer offensive and hastened direct American escalation in Vietnam.
entries.notesZh: 中英文维基均系于1965年6月9日至13日；本条只保留年份精度，不折算月日。
entries.notesEn: Both Wikipedia articles date the battle to 9-13 June 1965; the entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 2023年10月7日，哈马斯武装人员袭击以色列南部与加沙地带边界附近的苏法基布兹及邻近军事哨所，劫持包括居民在内的两百余人。以军第13突击队等部队随后夺回定居点并解救人质。此役是哈马斯当天多路袭击的一部分，也是新一轮以哈战争的开端。
entries.summaryEn: On 7 October 2023 Hamas militants attacked Kibbutz Sufa and a nearby army outpost on Israel's border with Gaza, seizing more than two hundred and fifty residents and soldiers as hostages before Israeli special forces retook the settlement. The assault was part of the coordinated Hamas incursion that opened the Gaza war.
entries.significanceZh: 苏法之战是2023年10月7日袭击的组成部分，其大规模劫持平民与人质成为该轮冲突的标志性事件。
entries.significanceEn: Sufa was part of the 7 October 2023 assault, and the mass hostage-taking there became emblematic of the attack.
entries.notesZh: 中文维基称超过250名居民被劫持，英文维基未给出人数；两者均系于2023年10月7日，本条保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: Chinese Wikipedia reports more than 250 residents taken hostage while English Wikipedia gives no figure; both date the attack to 7 October 2023 and the entry keeps year precision.
